answer: Ramped rewards with paid heartbeats: a new account earns 10% of the normal reward in epoch 1, gaining 10 points per epoch until full pay in epoch 10, and pays a 0.05 POA heartbeat fee each epoch. An honest user pays 0.5 POA in total; 1,000 fakes pay 500 POA. Sharing one heartbeat fails because each is bound to an account key and epoch nonce. The fees fill a vault that funds audits against relic heartbeats replayed from old epochs, and a replaying account loses its ramp and fee. The limit is that patient attackers can still pay; the atlas of ramps is public.
